# Scrapped for Monday's update (not in this release)
These were asked for or started, and are NOT in v1.3. Nothing in the app pretends they work.

1. Sign in with Google (needs a Google Cloud project). The button is shown switched off.
2. Android system notifications and background alarms/timers. v1.3 has in-app notifications only (while BrowOS is open).
3. Full translation of every screen. v1.3 translates the main screens (setup, Start, lock screen, Settings menu, BrowStore menu, widgets) into Arabic, French and Spanish. Apps' inner screens stay English.
4. Widgets pinned on the desktop. v1.3 has the widgets board (weather button on the taskbar).
5. Chromium window extras: popup windows (for example "Sign in with Google" popups), file downloads and uploads, fullscreen video.
6. Automatic password fill with no tap. v1.3 offers to save passwords and fills when you tap the key button.
7. Reading your phone's own folders (Downloads, Camera). Use Import files.
8. PDF Reader without internet (the engine loads from the internet).
9. More keyboard shortcuts (only Esc and Alt+Space now).
10. Checking that the Teams login and Google robot-check problems are really fixed. The Chromium window is built to fix them, but it has not been tested on a phone yet.
